name: Nobu Hotel Ibiza Bay
insider_take: Where Japanese minimalism meets Balearic bliss in a stunning cliffside sanctuary overlooking Talamanca Bay.
whats_special: This is the first Nobu hotel in Spain, featuring world-renowned chef Nobu Matsuhisa's signature restaurant with panoramic sea views. The property seamlessly blends traditional Japanese design with Ibiza's natural beauty, offering exclusive beach club access and suites with private infinity pools carved into the clifftop.
pro_tip: Book dinner at the Nobu restaurant during sunset for the most Instagram-worthy dining experience - the terrace offers unobstructed views of Ibiza's legendary golden hour over Talamanca Bay.
dont_miss: The hotel's private beach club Nobu Beach Club with its floating pontoon, and the Six Senses Spa featuring traditional Japanese treatments. Take the complimentary shuttle to explore Ibiza Town's UNESCO World Heritage old quarter, just 5 minutes away.
pros: World-renowned Nobu dining and culinary excellence
Prime Ibiza Bay waterfront location with stunning sea views
Luxurious modern design with Japanese-inspired aesthetics
Exclusive beach club and premium spa facilities
cons: Seasonal operation typically May through October
